english: A bag contains three identical white balls and three balls of different colours (one red, one green and one blue). Let $N_{1}$ be the number of ways of selecting three balls from the bag. Let $N_{2}$ be the number of ways of selecting three balls if the three white balls are numbered 1, 2, 3, so that all six balls are distinguishable. Then the value of $\dfrac{N_{1}}{N_{2}}$ is ______.
hindi: एक थैले में तीन सर्वसम सफ़ेद गेंदें तथा भिन्न रंगों की तीन गेंदें (एक लाल, एक हरी तथा एक नीली) हैं। माना कि $N_{1}$ थैले में से तीन गेंदें चुनने के तरीकों की संख्या है। माना कि $N_{2}$ तीन गेंदें चुनने के तरीकों की संख्या है यदि तीनों सफ़ेद गेंदों पर 1, 2, 3 अंकित हों, जिससे सभी छः गेंदें विभेद्य हो जाएँ। तब $\dfrac{N_{1}}{N_{2}}$ का मान ______ है।
solution: $N_{1}$: choose $k$ coloured balls ($\binom{3}{k}$), the rest white (one way, $3-k\leq3$): $\sum_{k=0}^{3}\binom{3}{k}=2^{3}=8$
solution_full: With identical white balls, a selection is fixed by which coloured balls it contains; if it contains $k$ coloured balls ($\binom{3}{k}$ ways), it contains $3-k$ white balls, and there is only one way to take them because they are identical (and $3-k\leq3$ are available).
originality_note: New: the same selection counted with identical and with distinguishable copies, where the identical white balls make every subset of the coloured balls give exactly one selection (2^3), compared with C(6,3) (way 5). Closest known: selections of r objects from p alike and q distinct objects. Different because: the ratio isolates the effect of identical copies.
blueprint_concepts: Selection of r objects from n distinct objects
Selection from a mix of distinct and identical objects

concept_use.Selection of r objects from n distinct o: N2 = C(6,3) is the selection of 3 objects from 6 distinct objects.
concept_use.Selection from a mix of distinct and ide: N1 is a selection from a mix of identical (white) and distinct (coloured) balls, equal to the number of subsets of the coloured balls.
